condensate.heading: Condensate
condensate.subheading: Premium Hydrocarbon Liquid from Natural Gas
condensate.body: Condensate is a hydrocarbon liquid formed from natural gas, primarily during oil and gas production processes. Condensate has properties similar to gasoline - it is flammable and liquid at normal temperature and pressure conditions. Condensate has various uses, including as a solvent in the paint, pharmaceutical, and adhesive industries; as fuel; and as a raw material in the petrochemical industry.

valueChain.heading: SPE Business Value Chain
valueChain.subheading: From gas source to end consumer
valueChain.imageAlt: PT Sarana Piranti Energi value chain infographic - 6 stages from exploration to consumer

steps.title: Gas Exploration
steps.body: Pertamina or national/international private companies extract natural gas from oil wells or gas wells.

steps.title: Gas Processing
steps.body: Processing natural gas from oil & gas fields into products: LPG, Condensate, and CNG (Lean Gas).

steps.title: Transportation
steps.body: Distribution of products from processing facilities to distribution and storage points using specialized tanker fleets.

steps.title: LPG Splitter
steps.body: Distillation: separating unstable LPG mixture fractions into lighter components, producing Butane & Propane.

steps.title: LPG Filling Station (SPBE)
steps.body: Bulk LPG Filling Station - a dedicated extension of Pertamina (Persero) to distribute LPG to the public.

steps.title: Consumer
steps.body: Natural gas products reach end consumers: households, industries, and commercial sectors across Indonesia.

items.title: Oil & Gas Product Trading
items.body: Buying and selling Condensate, LPG, and CNG as a primary player in Indonesia's oil and gas trading market.

items.title: Investment & Partnerships
items.body: Supporting Oil & Gas companies as a strategic investor in the development of gas projects and facilities.

items.title: Contracting Services
items.body: Contractor services for facility maintenance, infrastructure construction, as well as IT and network support for oil & gas operations.

items.title: Storage
items.body: Condensate storage facility in Bojonegoro, East Java - three tanks at 25 kL capacity each, self-owned.

futurePlans.heading: Development Plans
futurePlans.title: LPG & CNG Processing
futurePlans.body: SPE plans to build LPG and CNG processing facilities as a strategic step from a trading company toward an integrated production company. This investment will strengthen SPE's position in Indonesia's natural gas industry value chain.
